verdicts.reason: A: headline and CTA are strong and well grouped, but the date card (the key event info) is shrunk to an unreadable icon next to the logo. The eyebrow is microscopic, a blown-up crop of the decorative strip fills almost half the canvas, and the body copy is cramped and tiny beside the controller. B: the date card is again tiny and its time line can't be read. The reading order is jumbled, with the eyebrow placed under the body copy, and the decorative strip is crushed into a thin broken sliver. Left-aligned and centred elements are mixed with no shared axis, and the controller is a trivial speck, so the whole thing looks like scattered fragments.
